infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RASEED uses the camera to photograph receipts. The photo is read on this device and is never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RASEED reads receipts you choose from your photos. Reading happens on this device and nothing is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: RASEED can lock itself behind Face ID after five minutes away, so your ledger is not readable if someone picks up your unlocked phone.

plugins.microphonePermission: RASEED listens only while you are on the capture screen and have tapped the mic, to turn what you say into a transaction you then confirm. No audio is stored.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: RASEED requests on-device recognition only, so what you say is turned into text on this phone and the text is never uploaded. The notice above is Apple's, and applies to apps that use its servers.
